svg.title: How sedge works
svg.desc: Channels, signals, timers, the terminal and other agents put events into the inbox, which drops repeats, batches, triages and keeps to your limits. It starts runs on pi-durable, many at once, which work with memory, skills, MCP servers, tools (optionally sandboxed), approvals and subagents. What a run sends leaves through the outbox to you on your channel, and your reply comes back as an event.
svg.text: your reply comes back as an event
pi-durable · many at once · each picks up after a restart
